axis: bare capacity to tell things apart → refined taste that earns praise

members.tone: Praise for judgment fine enough to show itself in taste, where *selective* reports only that choices are being made.
Warm rather than cool - the judgment it names is a favourable one, or else plain appreciation, where *discriminating* says only that the judgment is fine.
Flatly technical: a capacity to tell things apart, carrying none of the credit *discriminating* hands whoever has it.
The same bare power of distinguishing, stated as a property of the thing that separates rather than a compliment to it.
Praise aimed at fineness of perception - it can both produce and catch effects too subtle for a coarser eye, where *selective* only picks among what is already plain.
A faculty word - the fineness sits in the distinctions themselves, not in any credit to whoever makes them.
Names the same capacity as *discriminative* and stays as neutral about it, describing a power to separate rather than approving its exercise.
Approving of breadth: the choosing ranges across styles and takes the best of each, where *selective* only narrows.
The broadest approval here - admiration granted with none of the account of the judgment behind it that *discriminating* insists on.
Mild credit for care in choosing, covering both the habit of picking and the carefulness of the pick, without claiming the taste *discriminating* asserts.
